text:
mike: heads-up — flipped the v2-default flag for tenant `acme-ux` around 11:12 PT to start the canary. small traffic, but console shows a weird quota attribution spike and a lot of `fallback_to_v1` events. anyone watching routing/telemetry?

opsbot: deploy event: toggle `tenant:acme-ux` v2-default=true @ 2024-11-03T18:12:08Z (user: mike) :white_check_mark:

anya: seeing it now. per-route tokens chart shows token attribution jumping on the v1 line even though trace shows routing to v2 for most requests. looks like counting path still uses the old meter key.

tess: quick q — did we enable sticky-pin for this canary? if pinning TTL > 0 that might explain double-counting when fallback triggers.

mike: pinning is on with TTL=300s for this tenant (we usually leave a short TTL for canaries). i set it via the console toggle.

rob: can you paste a sample trace id? i want to check the router logs vs billing pipeline.

anya: trace: `trace-20241103-7a9f`. here's the short grep from router: `ROUTER: req=abcd seq=1 chosen_route=v2 variant=q8f fallback=false` then later `FALLBACK PROXY: req=abcd cause=kvcache-miss policy=soft-fallback` — mismatched signals.

mike: hmm. console-bot link: https://console.redwood.company/tenants/acme-ux/routes?from=18:00&to=18:20 — the stacked chart is confusing because the legend orders by meter-key not chosen_route.

console-bot: note: dashboard metric `tokens_by_meter` aggregates by meter_key. if meter_key mapping lags routing rules, UX will show tokens under previous meter until background sync completes.

rob: aha — that matches. we recently added a memoized meter-key cache in the billing service to avoid DB hits; it refreshes every 5m. canary flip changes meter_key mapping but memoized value stayed stale, so billing attributed to old key for some requests that routed to v2.

tess: is the memoization safe to short-circuit for canaries? we could add a `tenant-flags` bypass for memo cache during graceful rollouts.

anya: short-term mitigation: set pin TTL=0 for the tenant so we avoid cross-version sticky behavior and reduce fallback churn. also bump billing cache ttl to 30s for `canary-*` tenants.

mike: i'm happy to flip TTL=0 now. who can change billing cache TTL param?

rob: i can push a hotfix to set memo_cache.ttl to 30s for keys matching `tenant:acme-*`. will do in the next 10m.

opsbot: prod-config-change: set `pin.ttl=0` for `tenant=acme-ux` by mike — scheduled immediately.

mike: done — pin TTL=0. console shows the per-route chart re-aligning but still seeing a handful of tokens reported under v1.

rob: pushing the billing cache change now. patch: `git push; deploy billing-service canary`

rob: deployed billing-service canary with `memo_cache.ttl=30s` for `acme-*` keys. monitoring focused on token attribution and cost meter.

anya: telemetry sampling: can we temporarily increase trace-level sampling for this tenant so we get more full traces for postmortem?

tess: yes — add `trace.sample_override: tenant=acme-ux => 100%` in runtime flags for 1h. opsbot can do that.

opsbot: runtime-flag: `trace.sample_override(acme-ux)=100%` active for 60m.

mike: after the billing patch + pin TTL change, attribution looks correct 10m in. rolling window shows fallback events drop to near-zero. good sign.

anya: follow-ups — we should do two things to avoid this in future: 1) console UX: surface `meter_key` vs `chosen_route` with an explicit annotation and table so PMs don't misread charts; 2) infra: add a memo_cache-invalidation signal when tenant route config toggles.

rob: agree. for 2) we can emit `config-change` events to the billing service via pubsub; billing will invalidate memo when sees a `tenant-routing:update` message. low-risk.

tess: for 1) UX proposal: add a toggle on the routes dashboard "show by chosen route / show by billing key" + hover tooltip explaining eventual consistency windows. small copy change plus a client-side selector. i can sketch the mock.

mike: sounds good. ask: do we need an immediate console toast when canary toggles so folks know metrics may lag?

anya: yes — add ephemeral toast for toggles: "Note: billing attribution may take up to 5 minutes to reflect route changes" with link to docs.

mike: i'll file a short RFC with the infra change and UX mock. i'll own the RFC and follow up on rollout checklist to add memo invalidation to the canary playbook. assigning owners: rob for memo invalidation patch, tess for dashboard mock, anya for toast + docs copy.

rob: ack, i'll start the pubsub patch and add a small e2e to ensure billing key re-read on `tenant-routing:update`.

opsbot: reminder created: `RFC-4523` "memo-cache invalidation for tenant route flips" assigned to rob, due EOD next Tue.

mike: thanks everyone. closing thread once RFC up. :thumbsup:
